virksomhed.label: What happens next?
virksomhed.say: Next you bring in knowledge – from the website, a file or text – and set up phone and/or chat. Finally subscription and payment, and you go live.

viden.label: What does Dialogbot use?
viden.say: Only what you have approved. Suggestions from the website, files and text are drafts until you approve them.

viden.label: Can I add more later?
viden.say: Yes. Everything is under Knowledge, and you can always bring in more or correct it.

telefon.label: How do I forward calls?
telefon.say: Dial the code from the phone step on your phone and press call. Turn forwarding off again with the code below it.

telefon.label: Can I undo it?
telefon.say: Yes. You can pause Dialogbot from Today and turn forwarding off on your phone.

chat.label: Where do I put the line?
chat.say: Just before </body> on the website – or send it to your web person with the button. It does nothing until the chat is live.

chat.label: When does the chat go live?
chat.say: Once the subscription is in place. Until then you can try it here in the preview.

kalender.label: What do you write in the calendar?
kalender.say: An appointment with the customer's name, number and errand – and a confirmation to you. I never touch your existing appointments.

kalender.label: Can I skip it?
kalender.say: Yes. Without a calendar Dialogbot takes a message, and you call back.

betaling.label: Why pay first?
betaling.say: Neither phone nor chat goes live without a paid subscription. Until then you can try the chat in the preview.

betaling.label: Can I undo it?
betaling.say: Yes. You can pause Dialogbot from Today.
